allow: PowerShell(if \(-not \(Test-Path "d:\\village"\)\) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "d:\\village" | Out-Null }; Get-ChildItem "d:\\village" -Force | Select-Object Name)

PowerShell(Set-Location "d:\\village"; $env:NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED = "1"; if \(Test-Path ".next"\) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force ".next" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; npx --yes next build 2>&1 | Out-String)

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conn\) { $conn | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; $left = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($left\) { "Still in use by PID: $\($left.OwningProcess\)" } else { "Port 3000 free ✓" })

PowerShell($listening = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($listening\) { "Still LISTENING on 3000: PID $\($listening.OwningProcess\)" } else { "Port 3000 LISTEN: free ✓ \(any remaining TIME_WAIT entries clear themselves\)" }; Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object | ForEach-Object { "Node processes running: $\($_.Count\)" })
